versionsUsed.bun: 1.4.0 (not used for this app; present on host)

pnpmNotes: The host has a 'nub' shim at ~/.nub/shims/pnpm that intercepts `pnpm` and refuses to run when invoked from a directory containing a bun lockfile (e.g. the cognate repo root, which has bun.lock). Running pnpm from inside the deepseek-harness clone (which has its own pnpm-lock.yaml, no bun.lock) works fine through the same shim (auto-installs pnpm 11.7.0 on first use). `npx -y pnpm@11.7.0` also works as a fallback. `corepack` on this host points at a Windows path with CRLF line endings and is broken (bad interpreter) — not needed since the nub shim/npx path works.
buildDurationApprox: under 1 minute for build:web portion (full `pnpm run build` includes native addon + host/client lib builds; total run completed within the 590s timeout)

authHandoff.details: On `dsh web` startup the process prints exactly one line to stdout: `dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=<random>`. Visiting that URL (GET / with ?token=... query param) establishes a session (sets a cookie); the plain root URL without the token responds 68-byte plain text: 'dsh web authentication required; reopen the URL printed by dsh web.' A bare HTTP fetch (node fetch / curl) to the token URL does NOT itself authenticate for a *subsequent* bare request unless cookies are preserved across requests (fetch/curl without a cookie jar re-sends no cookie). A real browser (Playwright) navigating to the token URL succeeds and is redirected/left at the clean root URL with the session established, confirmed by the smoke screenshot (page title 'DSH Local Build').
authHandoff.tokenSource: printed once to stdout on process start; not derivable from a config file; changes every launch

writtenContents: profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml (per-profile config override, written by Settings UI and hand-editable)
dataDirIsolation.note: Nothing was written under the real $HOME during this run; DSH_HOME fully redirects state. Profile name defaults to 'web' for `dsh web` launches, so the live-editable config path is $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml.
